g

The root project depends on `semantic-release@^21.0.2`, but three of the `semantic-release` plugin devDependencies were pinned to majors that only support older `semantic-release` versions as a peer:

- `@semantic-release/changelog@^5.0.1` → peer `semantic-release >=15.8.0 <18.0.0`
- `@semantic-release/commit-analyzer@^9.0.1` → peer `semantic-release <20`
- `@semantic-release/npm@^9.0.1` → peer `semantic-release <20`

That made `ERESOLVE unable to resolve dependency tree`.

## Fix

Bumped those three plugins in `package.json` to majors compatible with `semantic-release@21` and regenerated the lockfile:

- `@semantic-release/changelog` → `^6.0.3`
- `@semantic-release/commit-analyzer` → `^10.0.4`
- `@semantic-release/npm` → `^10.0.6`

`@semantic-release/release-notes-generator@^11.0.2` was already compatible, so it was left untouched. `package-lock.json` was updated via `npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts`, and the clean install now completes (878 packages, exit code 0).
